doc.title: Vince Lateano interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002

title: Briefly with Woody Herman and friendship with Sal Nistico
summary: He worked briefly with Woody Herman and stayed friends with Sal Nistico.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: I see you worked with Woody Herman.
And Sal Nistico was on the band.

Oh he was a wonderful musician, and a great guy. I really treasure that moment, that little bit of time where we got to — and then we remained friends and whenever he came through town, like he was here with oh a couple of different people, he was here with Tito Puente once, he was here with Gap Mangione in a little band. Different bands. And we’d always get together and hang out. I miss him. He was a great guy, a great player.
